1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
3	  A derived concept as data: a contract, typed formal arguments, formal parameters, and a body
4	  that is a `Formula` or a `Term` over atoms, primitives and other concepts. A rule names a
5	  concept (`Formula.derived`, `Term.quantity`) with actual arguments and parameter terms;
6	  `expand` replaces the name by the body with the actuals substituted, so evaluation, support
7	  and adequacy see atoms only.
8	
9	  A body references only its formals: every free `.var` is a formal argument, every `.param` a
10	  formal parameter. The bound variables of a body (quantifier variables, window subjects) are
11	  renamed on expansion, so an actual is never captured.
12	
13	  Declarations, substitution and expansion only; no evaluator. A concept file imports this
14	  module and nothing else. The static check is `Concept.check` in RuleEval.lean.
15	-/
16	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
17	
18	namespace TrafficSpec
19	
20	/-- The sort of a formal argument. A literal formal ranges over the admissible spellings; a region
21	    formal is the region the caller singles out, never one the body finds for itself. -/
22	inductive ArgSort
23	  | track
24	  | region
25	  /-- A literal formal is read only where a spelling is expected: the kind of a quantifier, or a
26	      literal argument of an atom or a primitive. No operator compares it with a spelling (`same`
27	      compares two bound variables), so a body decides alike for every value except through such a
28	      reading; notions that differ only by the value are separate concepts. -/
29	  | literal (values : List String)
30	  | nat
31	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
32	
33	structure ConceptParam where
34	  name : ParamName
35	  unit : PUnit'
36	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
37	
38	inductive ConceptBody
39	  | formula (φ : Formula)
40	  | quantity (t : Term)
41	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
42	
43	structure Concept where
44	  id : String                          -- drv.<family>.<name>
45	  contract : String
46	  definition : Option String := none   -- the corpus definition the contract quotes, when it has one
47	  args : List (String × ArgSort)
48	  params : List ConceptParam
49	  body : ConceptBody
50	  residues : List String := []
51	  narrowings : List Narrowing := []
52	  supersedes : Option String := none
53	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
54	
55	namespace Concept
56	
57	def leanName (c : Concept) : String := c.id.replace "." "_"
58	def isQuantity (c : Concept) : Bool := match c.body with | .quantity _ => true | _ => false
59	def trackFormals (c : Concept) : List String :=
60	  c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => if s == .track then some n else none
61	def regionFormals (c : Concept) : List String :=
62	  c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => if s == .region then some n else none
63	def paramNames (c : Concept) : List ParamName := c.params.map (·.name)
64	/-- The body as a formula, for the inspectors (a quantity as a trivial comparison of itself). -/
65	def bodyFormula (c : Concept) : Formula :=
66	  match c.body with
67	  | .formula φ => φ
68	  | .quantity t => .cmp t .eq t
69	/-- Instantiations that cover every admissible literal: the formals as themselves, then each
70	    literal value once with the other literals at their first value. -/
71	def samples (c : Concept) : List (List Arg) :=
72	  let base : List Arg := c.args.map fun (n, s) => match s with
73	    | .track | .region => Arg.var n
74	    | .literal vs => Arg.lit (vs.headD "")
75	    | .nat => Arg.nat 0
76	  let variants := (List.range c.args.length).flatMap fun i =>
77	    match (c.args[i]? : Option (String × ArgSort)) with
78	    | some (_, ArgSort.literal vs) => vs.map fun v => base.set i (Arg.lit v)
79	    | _ => []
80	  (base :: variants).eraseDups
81	
82	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
83	-- Substitution: formals ↦ actuals, bound variables renamed with a tag unique to the expansion.
84	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
85	structure Subst where
86	  vars : List (String × Arg)
87	  params : List (String × Term)
88	  tag : String
89	
90	namespace Subst
91	def arg (σ : Subst) : Arg → Arg
92	  | .var v => match σ.vars.find? (·.1 == v) with | some (_, a) => a | none => .var v
93	  | a => a
94	/-- A variable used by name (a window subject, a composition target). -/
95	def name (σ : Subst) (v : String) : String :=
96	  match σ.vars.find? (·.1 == v) with | some (_, .var w) => w | _ => v
97	/-- Bind a variable of the body: renamed with the tag, shadowing any formal of the same name. -/
98	def bind (σ : Subst) (v : String) : Subst × String :=
99	  let w := v ++ "#" ++ σ.tag
100	  ({ σ with vars := (v, .var w) :: σ.vars }, w)
101	end Subst
102	
103	mutual
104	  partial def substT (σ : Subst) : Term → Term
105	    | .lit q u => .lit q u
106	    | .param p => match σ.params.find? (·.1 == p) with | some (_, t) => t | none => .param p
107	    | .measure a args => .measure a (args.map σ.arg)
108	    | .quantity c args ps => .quantity c (args.map σ.arg) (ps.map (substT σ))
109	    | .distanceWhile s φ => .distanceWhile (σ.name s) (substF σ φ)
110	    | .sinceRise φ => .sinceRise (substF σ φ)
111	    | .headingSince s g ψ => .headingSince (σ.name s) (substT σ g) (substF σ ψ)
112	    | .aggregate op v φ t => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .aggregate op w (substF σ' φ) (substT σ' t)
113	    | .add a b => .add (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
114	    | .sub a b => .sub (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
115	    | .mul a b => .mul (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
116	    | .div a b => .div (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
117	    | .neg a => .neg (substT σ a)
118	    | .abs a => .abs (substT σ a)
119	    | .cond φ a b => .cond (substF σ φ) (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
120	  partial def substF (σ : Subst) : Formula → Formula
121	    | .tt => .tt
122	    | .ff => .ff
123	    | .atom n args ps => .atom n (args.map σ.arg) (ps.map (substT σ))
124	    | .cmp l op r => .cmp (substT σ l) op (substT σ r)
125	    | .asm id => .asm id
126	    | .intent id who target => .intent id (σ.arg who) (σ.arg target)
127	    | .same a b => .same (σ.arg a) (σ.arg b)
128	    | .not φ => .not (substF σ φ)
129	    | .and φ ψ => .and (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
130	    | .or φ ψ => .or (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
131	    | .implies φ ψ => .implies (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
132	    | .always φ => .always (substF σ φ)
133	    | .eventually φ => .eventually (substF σ φ)
134	    | .until φ ψ => .until (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
135	    | .since φ ψ => .since (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
136	    | .holdsFor m d s φ => .holdsFor m (substT σ d) (σ.name s) (substF σ φ)
137	    | .within m d s φ => .within m (substT σ d) (σ.name s) (substF σ φ)
138	    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => .untilWithin m (substT σ d) (σ.name s) (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
139	    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => .atLast m (substT σ d) (σ.name s) (substF σ ψ) (substF σ φ)
140	    | .count e s op n => .count (substF σ e) (substF σ s) op n
141	    | .rises φ => .rises (substF σ φ)
142	    | .definedWhen p φ => .definedWhen (substF σ p) (substF σ φ)
143	    | .derived c args ps => .derived c (args.map σ.arg) (ps.map (substT σ))
144	    | .rule id map => .rule id (map.map fun (i, o) => (i, σ.name o))
145	    | .ruleApplies id map => .ruleApplies id (map.map fun (i, o) => (i, σ.name o))
146	    | .existsUser v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .existsUser w (substF σ' φ)
147	    | .forallUser v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .forallUser w (substF σ' φ)
148	    | .existsRegion k v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .existsRegion (σ.arg k) w (substF σ' φ)
149	    | .forallRegion k v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .forallRegion (σ.arg k) w (substF σ' φ)
150	    | .existsDevice k v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .existsDevice (σ.arg k) w (substF σ' φ)
151	    | .forallDevice k v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .forallDevice (σ.arg k) w (substF σ' φ)
152	end
153	
154	/-- The body with the actuals substituted; `none` when an arity differs. -/
155	def instantiate (c : Concept) (args : List Arg) (ps : List Term) (tag : String) : Option ConceptBody :=
156	  if args.length != c.args.length || ps.length != c.params.length then none
157	  else
158	    let σ : Subst := { vars := (c.args.map (·.1)).zip args, params := (c.paramNames).zip ps, tag := tag }
159	    some (match c.body with
160	      | .formula φ => .formula (substF σ φ)
161	      | .quantity t => .quantity (substT σ t))
162	
163	/-- Atom, primitive and concept names the body reads, over every sample instantiation, so a
164	    quantifier whose kind is a literal formal reads every admissible kind. -/
165	def atoms (c : Concept) : List String :=
166	  let ps : List Term := c.params.map fun p => Term.param p.name
167	  ((samples c).flatMap fun args =>
168	    match instantiate c args ps "atoms" with
169	    | some (.formula φ) => Formula.atoms φ
170	    | some (.quantity t) => Formula.termAtoms t
171	    | none => Formula.atoms c.bodyFormula).eraseDups
172	/-- The concepts the body references, by Lean name. -/
173	def refs (c : Concept) : List String := (atoms c).filter (·.startsWith "drv_")
174	
175	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
176	-- Expansion: every concept call replaced by its body, `fuel` levels deep; a counter gives each
177	-- expansion its own tag. A name no concept carries, or a call of the wrong arity, is left as
178	-- it is for the static check to report.
179	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
180	private def nextTag : StateM Nat String := modifyGet fun k => (toString k, k + 1)
181	
182	mutual
183	  partial def expandT (cs : List Concept) (fuel : Nat) : Term → StateM Nat Term
184	    | .quantity n args ps => do
185	      let ps' ← ps.mapM (expandT cs fuel)
186	      match cs.find? (·.leanName == n), fuel with
187	      | some c, fuel' + 1 =>
188	        let tag ← nextTag
189	        match instantiate c args ps' tag with
190	        | some (.quantity t) => expandT cs fuel' t
191	        | _ => pure (.quantity n args ps')
192	      | _, _ => pure (.quantity n args ps')
193	    | .distanceWhile s φ => do pure (.distanceWhile s (← expandF cs fuel φ))
194	    | .sinceRise φ => do pure (.sinceRise (← expandF cs fuel φ))
195	    | .headingSince s g ψ => do pure (.headingSince s (← expandT cs fuel g) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
196	    | .aggregate op v φ t => do pure (.aggregate op v (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandT cs fuel t))
197	    | .add a b => do pure (.add (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
198	    | .sub a b => do pure (.sub (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
199	    | .mul a b => do pure (.mul (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
200	    | .div a b => do pure (.div (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
201	    | .neg a => do pure (.neg (← expandT cs fuel a))
202	    | .abs a => do pure (.abs (← expandT cs fuel a))
203	    | .cond φ a b => do pure (.cond (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
204	    | t => pure t
205	  partial def expandF (cs : List Concept) (fuel : Nat) : Formula → StateM Nat Formula
206	    | .derived n args ps => do
207	      let ps' ← ps.mapM (expandT cs fuel)
208	      match cs.find? (·.leanName == n), fuel with
209	      | some c, fuel' + 1 =>
210	        let tag ← nextTag
211	        match instantiate c args ps' tag with
212	        | some (.formula φ) => expandF cs fuel' φ
213	        | _ => pure (.derived n args ps')
214	      | _, _ => pure (.derived n args ps')
215	    | .atom n args ps => do pure (.atom n args (← ps.mapM (expandT cs fuel)))
216	    | .cmp l op r => do pure (.cmp (← expandT cs fuel l) op (← expandT cs fuel r))
217	    | .not φ => do pure (.not (← expandF cs fuel φ))
218	    | .and φ ψ => do pure (.and (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
219	    | .or φ ψ => do pure (.or (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
220	    | .implies φ ψ => do pure (.implies (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
221	    | .always φ => do pure (.always (← expandF cs fuel φ))
222	    | .eventually φ => do pure (.eventually (← expandF cs fuel φ))
223	    | .until φ ψ => do pure (.until (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
224	    | .since φ ψ => do pure (.since (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
225	    | .holdsFor m d s φ => do pure (.holdsFor m (← expandT cs fuel d) s (← expandF cs fuel φ))
226	    | .within m d s φ => do pure (.within m (← expandT cs fuel d) s (← expandF cs fuel φ))
227	    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => do
228	      pure (.untilWithin m (← expandT cs fuel d) s (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
229	    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => do
230	      pure (.atLast m (← expandT cs fuel d) s (← expandF cs fuel ψ) (← expandF cs fuel φ))
231	    | .count e s op n => do pure (.count (← expandF cs fuel e) (← expandF cs fuel s) op n)
232	    | .rises φ => do pure (.rises (← expandF cs fuel φ))
233	    | .definedWhen p φ => do pure (.definedWhen (← expandF cs fuel p) (← expandF cs fuel φ))
234	    | .existsUser v φ => do pure (.existsUser v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
235	    | .forallUser v φ => do pure (.forallUser v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
236	    | .existsRegion k v φ => do pure (.existsRegion k v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
237	    | .forallRegion k v φ => do pure (.forallRegion k v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
238	    | .existsDevice k v φ => do pure (.existsDevice k v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
239	    | .forallDevice k v φ => do pure (.forallDevice k v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
240	    | φ => pure φ
241	end
242	
243	/-- Every concept call expanded, to any depth the library allows. -/
244	def expand (cs : List Concept) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (expandF cs (cs.length + 1) φ).run' 0
245	def expandTerm (cs : List Concept) (t : Term) : Term := (expandT cs (cs.length + 1) t).run' 0
246	/-- The outermost calls only: a concept's witnesses exercise its own body, not the bodies of
247	    the concepts it uses. -/
248	def expandOnce (cs : List Concept) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (expandF cs 1 φ).run' 0
249	
250	def expandRule (cs : List Concept) (r : Rule) : Rule :=
251	  { r with binders := r.binders.map fun b => { b with cls := expand cs b.cls }
252	           applicability := expand cs r.applicability
253	           obligation := expand cs r.obligation }
254	
255	/-- The aggregate ids a rule names, its concept calls expanded to any depth: the ids the concepts'
256	    bodies name, with the actuals of each call substituted. -/
257	def ruleAggregateIds (cs : List Concept) (r : Rule) : List String :=
258	  ((expandRule cs r).formulas.flatMap Formula.aggregateIds).eraseDups
259	
260	/-- The aggregate ids a concept's body names, its calls expanded, over every sample instantiation
261	    of its literal formals. -/
262	def aggregateIds (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) : List String :=
263	  let ps : List Term := c.params.map fun p => Term.param p.name
264	  ((samples c).flatMap fun args =>
265	    match instantiate c args ps "aggregates" with
266	    | some (.formula φ) => Formula.aggregateIds (expand cs φ)
267	    | some (.quantity t) => Formula.termAggregateIds (expandTerm cs t)
268	    | none => Formula.aggregateIds (expand cs c.bodyFormula)).eraseDups
269	
270	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
271	-- Reference cycles
272	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
273	/-- Every concept name reachable from `start` through the references, `start` included. -/
274	def reachable (cs : List Concept) (start : List String) : List String :=
275	  let step (seen : List String) : List String :=
276	    (seen ++ seen.flatMap fun n => match cs.find? (·.leanName == n) with
277	      | some c => c.refs
278	      | none => []).eraseDups
279	  (List.range (cs.length + 1)).foldl (fun acc _ => step acc) start
280	
281	/-- The ids of the concepts that reach themselves. -/
282	def onCycle (cs : List Concept) : List String :=
283	  cs.filterMap fun c => if (reachable cs c.refs).contains c.leanName then some c.id else none
284	
285	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
286	-- Witness instances: a concept applied to named tracks, chosen literals and parameter terms,
287	-- as a rule the witness machinery can run. Track formals are the rule's binders, by name; region
288	-- formals stay variables, which each scenario of the instance binds to a region of its trace.
289	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
290	structure Instance where
291	  name : String
292	  concept : String                          -- the concept id
293	  literals : List (String × String) := []   -- literal formal ↦ spelling
294	  nats : List (String × Nat) := []
295	  params : List (String × Term) := []       -- formal parameter ↦ a constant term
296	  bounds : Option (Term × Term) := none     -- a quantity: the value lies in [lo, hi]
297	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
298

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
  A derived concept as data: a contract, typed formal arguments, formal parameters, and a body
  that is a `Formula` or a `Term` over atoms, primitives and other concepts. A rule names a
  concept (`Formula.derived`, `Term.quantity`) with actual arguments and parameter terms;
  `expand` replaces the name by the body with the actuals substituted, so evaluation, support
  and adequacy see atoms only.

  A body references only its formals: every free `.var` is a formal argument, every `.param` a
  formal parameter. The bound variables of a body (quantifier variables, window subjects) are
  renamed on expansion, so an actual is never captured.

  Declarations, substitution and expansion only; no evaluator. A concept file imports this
  module and nothing else. The static check is `Concept.check` in RuleEval.lean.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- The sort of a formal argument. A literal formal ranges over the admissible spellings; a region
    formal is the region the caller singles out, never one the body finds for itself. -/
inductive ArgSort
  | track
  | region
  /-- A literal formal is read only where a spelling is expected: the kind of a quantifier, or a
      literal argument of an atom or a primitive. No operator compares it with a spelling (`same`
      compares two bound variables), so a body decides alike for every value except through such a
      reading; notions that differ only by the value are separate concepts. -/
  | literal (values : List String)
  | nat
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

structure ConceptParam where
  name : ParamName
  unit : PUnit'
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

inductive ConceptBody
  | formula (φ : Formula)
  | quantity (t : Term)
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

structure Concept where
  id : String                          -- drv.<family>.<name>
  contract : String
  definition : Option String := none   -- the corpus definition the contract quotes, when it has one
  args : List (String × ArgSort)
  params : List ConceptParam
  body : ConceptBody
  residues : List String := []
  narrowings : List Narrowing := []
  supersedes : Option String := none
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Concept

def leanName (c : Concept) : String := c.id.replace "." "_"
def isQuantity (c : Concept) : Bool := match c.body with | .quantity _ => true | _ => false
def trackFormals (c : Concept) : List String :=
  c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => if s == .track then some n else none
def regionFormals (c : Concept) : List String :=
  c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => if s == .region then some n else none
def paramNames (c : Concept) : List ParamName := c.params.map (·.name)
/-- The body as a formula, for the inspectors (a quantity as a trivial comparison of itself). -/
def bodyFormula (c : Concept) : Formula :=
  match c.body with
  | .formula φ => φ
  | .quantity t => .cmp t .eq t
/-- Instantiations that cover every admissible literal: the formals as themselves, then each
    literal value once with the other literals at their first value. -/
def samples (c : Concept) : List (List Arg) :=
  let base : List Arg := c.args.map fun (n, s) => match s with
    | .track | .region => Arg.var n
    | .literal vs => Arg.lit (vs.headD "")
    | .nat => Arg.nat 0
  let variants := (List.range c.args.length).flatMap fun i =>
    match (c.args[i]? : Option (String × ArgSort)) with
    | some (_, ArgSort.literal vs) => vs.map fun v => base.set i (Arg.lit v)
    | _ => []
  (base :: variants).eraseDups

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Substitution: formals ↦ actuals, bound variables renamed with a tag unique to the expansion.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Subst where
  vars : List (String × Arg)
  params : List (String × Term)
  tag : String

namespace Subst
def arg (σ : Subst) : Arg → Arg
  | .var v => match σ.vars.find? (·.1 == v) with | some (_, a) => a | none => .var v
  | a => a
/-- A variable used by name (a window subject, a composition target). -/
def name (σ : Subst) (v : String) : String :=
  match σ.vars.find? (·.1 == v) with | some (_, .var w) => w | _ => v
/-- Bind a variable of the body: renamed with the tag, shadowing any formal of the same name. -/
def bind (σ : Subst) (v : String) : Subst × String :=
  let w := v ++ "#" ++ σ.tag
  ({ σ with vars := (v, .var w) :: σ.vars }, w)
end Subst

mutual
  partial def substT (σ : Subst) : Term → Term
    | .lit q u => .lit q u
    | .param p => match σ.params.find? (·.1 == p) with | some (_, t) => t | none => .param p
    | .measure a args => .measure a (args.map σ.arg)
    | .quantity c args ps => .quantity c (args.map σ.arg) (ps.map (substT σ))
    | .distanceWhile s φ => .distanceWhile (σ.name s) (substF σ φ)
    | .sinceRise φ => .sinceRise (substF σ φ)
    | .headingSince s g ψ => .headingSince (σ.name s) (substT σ g) (substF σ ψ)
    | .aggregate op v φ t => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .aggregate op w (substF σ' φ) (substT σ' t)
    | .add a b => .add (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
    | .sub a b => .sub (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
    | .mul a b => .mul (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
    | .div a b => .div (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
    | .neg a => .neg (substT σ a)
    | .abs a => .abs (substT σ a)
    | .cond φ a b => .cond (substF σ φ) (substT σ a) (substT σ b)
  partial def substF (σ : Subst) : Formula → Formula
    | .tt => .tt
    | .ff => .ff
    | .atom n args ps => .atom n (args.map σ.arg) (ps.map (substT σ))
    | .cmp l op r => .cmp (substT σ l) op (substT σ r)
    | .asm id => .asm id
    | .intent id who target => .intent id (σ.arg who) (σ.arg target)
    | .same a b => .same (σ.arg a) (σ.arg b)
    | .not φ => .not (substF σ φ)
    | .and φ ψ => .and (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
    | .or φ ψ => .or (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
    | .implies φ ψ => .implies (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
    | .always φ => .always (substF σ φ)
    | .eventually φ => .eventually (substF σ φ)
    | .until φ ψ => .until (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
    | .since φ ψ => .since (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
    | .holdsFor m d s φ => .holdsFor m (substT σ d) (σ.name s) (substF σ φ)
    | .within m d s φ => .within m (substT σ d) (σ.name s) (substF σ φ)
    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => .untilWithin m (substT σ d) (σ.name s) (substF σ φ) (substF σ ψ)
    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => .atLast m (substT σ d) (σ.name s) (substF σ ψ) (substF σ φ)
    | .count e s op n => .count (substF σ e) (substF σ s) op n
    | .rises φ => .rises (substF σ φ)
    | .definedWhen p φ => .definedWhen (substF σ p) (substF σ φ)
    | .derived c args ps => .derived c (args.map σ.arg) (ps.map (substT σ))
    | .rule id map => .rule id (map.map fun (i, o) => (i, σ.name o))
    | .ruleApplies id map => .ruleApplies id (map.map fun (i, o) => (i, σ.name o))
    | .existsUser v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .existsUser w (substF σ' φ)
    | .forallUser v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .forallUser w (substF σ' φ)
    | .existsRegion k v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .existsRegion (σ.arg k) w (substF σ' φ)
    | .forallRegion k v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .forallRegion (σ.arg k) w (substF σ' φ)
    | .existsDevice k v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .existsDevice (σ.arg k) w (substF σ' φ)
    | .forallDevice k v φ => let (σ', w) := σ.bind v; .forallDevice (σ.arg k) w (substF σ' φ)
end

/-- The body with the actuals substituted; `none` when an arity differs. -/
def instantiate (c : Concept) (args : List Arg) (ps : List Term) (tag : String) : Option ConceptBody :=
  if args.length != c.args.length || ps.length != c.params.length then none
  else
    let σ : Subst := { vars := (c.args.map (·.1)).zip args, params := (c.paramNames).zip ps, tag := tag }
    some (match c.body with
      | .formula φ => .formula (substF σ φ)
      | .quantity t => .quantity (substT σ t))

/-- Atom, primitive and concept names the body reads, over every sample instantiation, so a
    quantifier whose kind is a literal formal reads every admissible kind. -/
def atoms (c : Concept) : List String :=
  let ps : List Term := c.params.map fun p => Term.param p.name
  ((samples c).flatMap fun args =>
    match instantiate c args ps "atoms" with
    | some (.formula φ) => Formula.atoms φ
    | some (.quantity t) => Formula.termAtoms t
    | none => Formula.atoms c.bodyFormula).eraseDups
/-- The concepts the body references, by Lean name. -/
def refs (c : Concept) : List String := (atoms c).filter (·.startsWith "drv_")

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Expansion: every concept call replaced by its body, `fuel` levels deep; a counter gives each
-- expansion its own tag. A name no concept carries, or a call of the wrong arity, is left as
-- it is for the static check to report.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def nextTag : StateM Nat String := modifyGet fun k => (toString k, k + 1)

mutual
  partial def expandT (cs : List Concept) (fuel : Nat) : Term → StateM Nat Term
    | .quantity n args ps => do
      let ps' ← ps.mapM (expandT cs fuel)
      match cs.find? (·.leanName == n), fuel with
      | some c, fuel' + 1 =>
        let tag ← nextTag
        match instantiate c args ps' tag with
        | some (.quantity t) => expandT cs fuel' t
        | _ => pure (.quantity n args ps')
      | _, _ => pure (.quantity n args ps')
    | .distanceWhile s φ => do pure (.distanceWhile s (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .sinceRise φ => do pure (.sinceRise (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .headingSince s g ψ => do pure (.headingSince s (← expandT cs fuel g) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
    | .aggregate op v φ t => do pure (.aggregate op v (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandT cs fuel t))
    | .add a b => do pure (.add (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
    | .sub a b => do pure (.sub (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
    | .mul a b => do pure (.mul (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
    | .div a b => do pure (.div (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
    | .neg a => do pure (.neg (← expandT cs fuel a))
    | .abs a => do pure (.abs (← expandT cs fuel a))
    | .cond φ a b => do pure (.cond (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandT cs fuel a) (← expandT cs fuel b))
    | t => pure t
  partial def expandF (cs : List Concept) (fuel : Nat) : Formula → StateM Nat Formula
    | .derived n args ps => do
      let ps' ← ps.mapM (expandT cs fuel)
      match cs.find? (·.leanName == n), fuel with
      | some c, fuel' + 1 =>
        let tag ← nextTag
        match instantiate c args ps' tag with
        | some (.formula φ) => expandF cs fuel' φ
        | _ => pure (.derived n args ps')
      | _, _ => pure (.derived n args ps')
    | .atom n args ps => do pure (.atom n args (← ps.mapM (expandT cs fuel)))
    | .cmp l op r => do pure (.cmp (← expandT cs fuel l) op (← expandT cs fuel r))
    | .not φ => do pure (.not (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .and φ ψ => do pure (.and (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
    | .or φ ψ => do pure (.or (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
    | .implies φ ψ => do pure (.implies (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
    | .always φ => do pure (.always (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .eventually φ => do pure (.eventually (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .until φ ψ => do pure (.until (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
    | .since φ ψ => do pure (.since (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
    | .holdsFor m d s φ => do pure (.holdsFor m (← expandT cs fuel d) s (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .within m d s φ => do pure (.within m (← expandT cs fuel d) s (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => do
      pure (.untilWithin m (← expandT cs fuel d) s (← expandF cs fuel φ) (← expandF cs fuel ψ))
    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => do
      pure (.atLast m (← expandT cs fuel d) s (← expandF cs fuel ψ) (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .count e s op n => do pure (.count (← expandF cs fuel e) (← expandF cs fuel s) op n)
    | .rises φ => do pure (.rises (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .definedWhen p φ => do pure (.definedWhen (← expandF cs fuel p) (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .existsUser v φ => do pure (.existsUser v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .forallUser v φ => do pure (.forallUser v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .existsRegion k v φ => do pure (.existsRegion k v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .forallRegion k v φ => do pure (.forallRegion k v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .existsDevice k v φ => do pure (.existsDevice k v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | .forallDevice k v φ => do pure (.forallDevice k v (← expandF cs fuel φ))
    | φ => pure φ
end

/-- Every concept call expanded, to any depth the library allows. -/
def expand (cs : List Concept) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (expandF cs (cs.length + 1) φ).run' 0
def expandTerm (cs : List Concept) (t : Term) : Term := (expandT cs (cs.length + 1) t).run' 0
/-- The outermost calls only: a concept's witnesses exercise its own body, not the bodies of
    the concepts it uses. -/
def expandOnce (cs : List Concept) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (expandF cs 1 φ).run' 0

def expandRule (cs : List Concept) (r : Rule) : Rule :=
  { r with binders := r.binders.map fun b => { b with cls := expand cs b.cls }
           applicability := expand cs r.applicability
           obligation := expand cs r.obligation }

/-- The aggregate ids a rule names, its concept calls expanded to any depth: the ids the concepts'
    bodies name, with the actuals of each call substituted. -/
def ruleAggregateIds (cs : List Concept) (r : Rule) : List String :=
  ((expandRule cs r).formulas.flatMap Formula.aggregateIds).eraseDups

/-- The aggregate ids a concept's body names, its calls expanded, over every sample instantiation
    of its literal formals. -/
def aggregateIds (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) : List String :=
  let ps : List Term := c.params.map fun p => Term.param p.name
  ((samples c).flatMap fun args =>
    match instantiate c args ps "aggregates" with
    | some (.formula φ) => Formula.aggregateIds (expand cs φ)
    | some (.quantity t) => Formula.termAggregateIds (expandTerm cs t)
    | none => Formula.aggregateIds (expand cs c.bodyFormula)).eraseDups

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Reference cycles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Every concept name reachable from `start` through the references, `start` included. -/
def reachable (cs : List Concept) (start : List String) : List String :=
  let step (seen : List String) : List String :=
    (seen ++ seen.flatMap fun n => match cs.find? (·.leanName == n) with
      | some c => c.refs
      | none => []).eraseDups
  (List.range (cs.length + 1)).foldl (fun acc _ => step acc) start

/-- The ids of the concepts that reach themselves. -/
def onCycle (cs : List Concept) : List String :=
  cs.filterMap fun c => if (reachable cs c.refs).contains c.leanName then some c.id else none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Witness instances: a concept applied to named tracks, chosen literals and parameter terms,
-- as a rule the witness machinery can run. Track formals are the rule's binders, by name; region
-- formals stay variables, which each scenario of the instance binds to a region of its trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Instance where
  name : String
  concept : String                          -- the concept id
  literals : List (String × String) := []   -- literal formal ↦ spelling
  nats : List (String × Nat) := []
  params : List (String × Term) := []       -- formal parameter ↦ a constant term
  bounds : Option (Term × Term) := none     -- a quantity: the value lies in [lo, hi]
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- The instance as a rule: every track formal a binder of class `tt`, applicability `tt`, the
    body (its own calls expanded once) as the obligation. `none` when the concept is not in the
    list or the instance leaves a formal unfilled. -/
def asRule (cs : List Concept) (i : Instance) : Option Rule := do
  let c ← cs.find? (·.id == i.concept)
  let args : List Arg ← c.args.mapM fun (n, s) => match s with
    | .track | .region => some (.var n)
    | .literal _ => (i.literals.find? (·.1 == n)).map fun (_, v) => Arg.lit v
    | .nat => (i.nats.find? (·.1 == n)).map fun (_, k) => Arg.nat k
  let ps : List Term ← c.params.mapM fun p => (i.params.find? (·.1 == p.name)).map (·.2)
  let value : Term := .quantity c.leanName args ps
  let call : Formula ← match c.body, i.bounds with
    | .formula _, _ => some (Formula.derived c.leanName args ps)
    | .quantity _, some (lo, hi) => some (Formula.and (Formula.cmp lo .le value) (Formula.cmp value .le hi))
    | .quantity _, none => none
  pure { id := i.name
         laws := []
         binders := (trackFormals c).map fun n => ⟨n, .tt⟩
         applicability := .tt
         obligation := expandOnce cs call }

/-- Each formal named exactly once among the names given, and no name that is not a formal. -/
private def givenOnce (where_ what : String) (formals given : List String) : List String :=
  (formals.filter (fun f => given.count f != 1)).map (fun f => s!"{where_}: {what} formal `{f}` given {given.count f} times") ++
  (given.eraseDups.filter (!formals.contains ·)).map fun g => s!"{where_}: `{g}` is no {what} formal"

/-- What is wrong with an instance's values: a concept the list lacks, a literal, nat or
    parameter formal not given exactly once, a name that is no formal of its sort, a literal
    outside its admissible values. -/
def Instance.defects (cs : List Concept) (i : Instance) : List String :=
  match cs.find? (·.id == i.concept) with
  | none => [s!"{i.name}: concept `{i.concept}` is not in the list"]
  | some c =>
    let lits := c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with | .literal _ => some n | _ => none
    let nats := c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => if s == .nat then some n else none
    givenOnce i.name "literal" lits (i.literals.map (·.1)) ++
    givenOnce i.name "nat" nats (i.nats.map (·.1)) ++
    givenOnce i.name "parameter" c.paramNames (i.params.map (·.1)) ++
    i.literals.filterMap fun (n, v) => match c.args.find? (·.1 == n) with
      | some (_, .literal vs) => if vs.contains v then none else some s!"{i.name}: literal `{n}` is `{v}`, not one of {vs}"
      | _ => none

/-- What is wrong with the regions a scenario or a challenge gives an instance: each region formal
    given exactly once, and no name that is not one. -/
def regionDefects (c : Concept) (where_ : String) (regions : List (String × RegionId)) : List String :=
  givenOnce where_ "region" c.regionFormals (regions.map (·.1))

end Concept
end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
3	  Evaluating a rule over a trace, and checking it before any trace.
4	
5	  `verdicts` combines the binder classes, the applicability and the obligation per instant
6	  (Kleene, `verdictAt`). `check` finds from the syntax every defect the evaluator would otherwise
7	  report as `malformed` or `unboundVariable`; its doc comment lists them. `checkReading`
8	  names the parameters and aggregates the reading lacks, over the rule and the rules it composes,
9	  with their concept calls expanded; `Concept.checkReading` the aggregates a concept's body names.
10	
11	  `Concept.check` holds a concept to the same standard on every admissible instantiation of
12	  its formals, with its calls expanded. `Concept.callDefects` holds every concept call to the
13	  callee's signature before expansion loses it.
14	
15	  Nothing under Rules/ or Concepts/ imports this file; Grounding, Manifest and Monitor do.
16	-/
17	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
18	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.EvalFast
21	
22	namespace TrafficSpec
23	namespace Rule
24	open Semantics
25	
26	/-- A rule's formula as evaluated: every comparison over a `cond` decided by cases, through the
27	    sub-expression cache (`evalFastAll`, whose every stored value is the one `evalAll` gives). -/
28	def evalRuleFormula (c : SemCtx) (φ : Formula) : Array R := evalFastAll c (Formula.elimCond φ)
29	
30	/-- Every binder's class holds for its bound track and the applicability holds, per instant. -/
31	def engagedAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
  Evaluating a rule over a trace, and checking it before any trace.

  `verdicts` combines the binder classes, the applicability and the obligation per instant
  (Kleene, `verdictAt`). `check` finds from the syntax every defect the evaluator would otherwise
  report as `malformed` or `unboundVariable`; its doc comment lists them. `checkReading`
  names the parameters and aggregates the reading lacks, over the rule and the rules it composes,
  with their concept calls expanded; `Concept.checkReading` the aggregates a concept's body names.

  `Concept.check` holds a concept to the same standard on every admissible instantiation of
  its formals, with its calls expanded. `Concept.callDefects` holds every concept call to the
  callee's signature before expansion loses it.

  Nothing under Rules/ or Concepts/ imports this file; Grounding, Manifest and Monitor do.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.EvalFast

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Rule
open Semantics

/-- A rule's formula as evaluated: every comparison over a `cond` decided by cases, through the
    sub-expression cache (`evalFastAll`, whose every stored value is the one `evalAll` gives). -/
def evalRuleFormula (c : SemCtx) (φ : Formula) : Array R := evalFastAll c (Formula.elimCond φ)

/-- Every binder's class holds for its bound track and the applicability holds, per instant. -/
def engagedAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  Temporal.allOf c.n (r.binders.map (fun b => evalRuleFormula c b.cls) ++ [evalRuleFormula c r.applicability])

/-- The verdict at every instant. -/
def verdicts (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array Verdict :=
  Array.zipWith verdictAt (r.engagedAll c) (evalRuleFormula c r.obligation)

/-- The rule as a three-valued statement per instant: complied with (true), violated (false), or
    unknown. Not engaged counts as complied with — a rule that does not apply is not broken. -/
def asRAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  (r.verdicts c).map fun v => match v with
    | .compliant | .notApplicable => R.t
    | .violated => R.f
    | .unknown w => ⟨.u, w⟩

/-- Structural well-formedness apart from having a binder: binders named and distinct, the id
    set, every assumption and intention used declared, every intention id well-formed, every
    operationalization bounding its standard by atoms, primitives or concepts. -/
def wellFormedBody (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  r.binderNames.eraseDups.length == r.binders.length &&
  r.binders.all (fun b => !b.name.isEmpty) &&
  !r.id.isEmpty &&
  r.usedAssumptions.all (r.assumptions.contains ·) &&
  r.usedIntentions.all (r.intentions.contains ·) &&
  r.intentions.all IntId.wellFormed &&
  r.operationalizations.all (fun o => !o.concepts.isEmpty && o.concepts.all fun c =>
    c.startsWith "drv." || Primitives.primitiveNames.contains (defName c) || knowsAtom (defName c))

/-- Structural well-formedness: at least one binder, and `wellFormedBody`. -/
def wellFormed (r : Rule) : Bool := !r.binders.isEmpty && r.wellFormedBody

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Static check
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Variables in scope with their sorts, the innermost first. -/
abbrev Scope := List (String × EntityKind)

/-- Whether `v` is bound and its innermost binding has sort `k`, as evaluation's lookup reads it. -/
def Scope.binds (scope : Scope) (v : String) (k : EntityKind) : Bool :=
  (scope.find? (·.1 == v)).map (·.2) == some k

/-- Resolve arguments against the scope with dummy ids, checking each variable's sort against the
    position's expected sort when the table knows it. An entity position takes a variable only:
    a literal or a number there would name a track, region or device the rule has no right to. -/
private def dummyArgs (scope : Scope) (sorts : Option (List (Option EntityKind))) (args : List Arg)
    : Except String (List Primitives.DArg) :=
  (args.zip (List.range args.length)).mapM fun (a, k) =>
    match a with
    | .var v =>
      match scope.find? (·.1 == v) with
      | none => .error s!"variable `{v}` is not bound"
      | some (_, vs) =>
        match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
        | some (some want) => if want == vs then .ok (.v 0) else .error s!"variable `{v}` has sort {repr vs}, position {k} wants {repr want}"
        | some none => .error s!"variable `{v}` where position {k} takes a literal"
        | none => .ok (.v 0)
    | .lit l =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"literal `{l}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.s l)
    | .nat n =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"number `{n}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.n n)

private def isMalformed : UnknownReason → Option String
  | .malformed w => some w
  | .parameterMissing w => some w
  | _ => none

private def emptyScene : Scene := { t := 0 }
private def emptyCtx : Primitives.Ctx := { scenes := #[], times := #[], ρ := {} }

/-- A quantifier's kind: a spelling the codec decodes. A variable is a concept's literal formal
    that reached the check unfilled. -/
private def kindErrors (where_ : String) (a : Arg) (what : String) (known : String → Bool) : List String :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => if known s then [] else [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{s}` names no kind"]
  | .var v => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{v}` is a variable; spell the kind, or fill it from a literal formal"]
  | .nat _ => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind is a number"]

private def constParamErrors (where_ name : String) (ps : List Term) : List String :=
  ps.filter (!Term.isConstant ·) |>.map fun _ => s!"{where_}: `{name}` parameter is not a constant term"

/-- A heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, a literal strictly positive. -/
private def stepErrors (where_ : String) : Term → List String
  | .lit q _ => if Q.lt Q.zero q then [] else [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not strictly positive"]
  | .param _ => []
  | _ => [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter"]

mutual
  partial def checkTerm (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
    | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
    | .measure a args =>
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts a) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"]
      | .ok ds => match evalMeasure emptyScene a ds with
        | .error w => match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: measure `{a}`: {m}"] | none => []
        | .ok _ => []
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalQ concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .sinceRise φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      stepErrors where_ g ++ checkTerm scope where_ g ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .aggregate _ v φ t => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ checkTerm ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b
    | .neg a | .abs a => checkTerm scope where_ a
    | .cond φ a b => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b

  partial def checkFormula (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
    | .tt | .ff | .asm _ => []

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate
3	  A rate integrated since a condition last became true, over the whole trace in one forward pass,
4	  and its specification over Lean's `Rat`.
5	
6	  The start at observation `i` is `Temporal.runStartAll`'s: the latest observation `j ≤ i` at which
7	  the condition rose definitely (false at `j − 1`, true at `j`), with the condition known at every
8	  observation of `(j, i]`. The value is Σ_{k ∈ (j, i]} rate_k · (t_k − t_{k−1}): zero at the start,
9	  the rate at an observation covering the interval that ends there. It is unknown, never a value,
10	  at every observation when the step bound is not positive; where the start is unknown or none is
11	  observed (`windowTruncated op`, or the condition's reason); where an interval ending at an
12	  observation of `[j, i]`, the one ending at the start included, is longer than the step bound
13	  (`samplingGap op`); where a rate of `(j, i]` is missing (`missing`).
14	
15	  Proved here: the start is exactly the latest definite rise with the condition known since; a
16	  decided value comes from such a start, a positive bound, intervals within the bound, present rates,
17	  and equals the discrete sum; each unknown case gives its reason; the value at `i` depends only on
18	  the inputs at observations `≤ i`; the sum splits at any intermediate observation.
19	-/
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
21	
22	namespace TrafficSpec
23	
24	/-- A rational's value in Lean's `Rat`. -/
25	def Q.val (q : Q) : Rat := mkRat q.num q.den
26	
27	namespace Accumulate
28	open Temporal
29	
30	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	-- The operator
32	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
33	/-- The running state at an observation: the sum of rate × interval since the trace start (a
34	    missing rate adds nothing), the latest observation whose rate is missing, and the latest
35	    observation reached across an interval longer than the step bound. -/
36	structure Run where
37	  sum : Q
38	  lastMissing : Option Nat
39	  lastWide : Option Nat
40	  deriving Inhabited
41	
42	def Run.init : Run := ⟨Q.zero, none, none⟩
43	
44	/-- The interval ending at observation `i`; zero at the first. -/
45	def dt (times : Array Q) (i : Nat) : Q := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub times[i]! times[i - 1]!
46	
47	/-- The state at observation `i` from the state at the observation before. -/
48	def runStep (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) (prev : Run) (i : Nat) : Run :=
49	  { sum := match rate[i]! with | some ω => Q.add prev.sum (Q.mul ω (dt times i)) | none => prev.sum
50	    lastMissing := if (rate[i]!).isNone then some i else prev.lastMissing
51	    lastWide := if i != 0 && Q.gt (dt times i) maxStep then some i else prev.lastWide }
52	
53	/-- The state at each of the first `n` observations, in one forward pass. -/
54	def runs (n : Nat) (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) : Array Run :=
55	  (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Run) i =>
56	    acc.push (runStep times rate maxStep (if i = 0 then Run.init else acc[i - 1]!) i)) #[]
57	
58	/-- The value at `i` from the starts and the states. -/
59	def valueAt (starts : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat))) (rs : Array Run) (op : String)
60	    (missing : UnknownReason) (i : Nat) : QR :=
61	  match starts[i]! with
62	  | .error e => .error e
63	  | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
64	  | .ok (some j) =>
65	    if (rs[i]!).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) then .error (.samplingGap op)
66	    else if (rs[i]!).lastMissing.any (j < ·) then .error missing
67	    else .ok (Q.sub (rs[i]!).sum (rs[j]!).sum)
68	
69	/-- Rate × interval accumulated since ψ last became true, per observation. -/
70	def sinceRiseIntegralAll (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) (op : String)
71	    (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ : Array R) : Array QR :=
72	  if Q.lt Q.zero maxStep then
73	    (Array.range ψ.size).map (valueAt (runStartAll op ψ) (runs ψ.size times rate maxStep) op missing)
74	  else Array.replicate ψ.size (.error (.malformed s!"{op} step bound is not positive"))
75	
76	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
77	-- The specification
78	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
79	/-- Σ_{k ∈ (j, i]} rate_k · (t_k − t_{k−1}) over `Rat`; none where a rate of `(j, i]` is missing;
80	    zero where `i ≤ j`. -/
81	def integral (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (j : Nat) : Nat → Option Rat
82	  | 0 => some 0
83	  | i + 1 => if i + 1 ≤ j then some 0 else do
84	      let acc ← integral times rate j i
85	      let ω ← rate[i + 1]!
86	      pure (acc + ω.val * ((times[i + 1]!).val - (times[i]!).val))
87	
88	/-- ψ rises definitely at `j`: false at the observation before, true there. -/
89	def RisesAt (ψ : Array R) (j : Nat) : Prop := 0 < j ∧ ψ[j - 1]!.v = .f ∧ ψ[j]!.v = .t
90	
91	/-- `j` is the start at `i`: a definite rise at `j ≤ i`, ψ known and rising nowhere in `(j, i]`. -/
92	def AnchorAt (ψ : Array R) (j i : Nat) : Prop :=
93	  j ≤ i ∧ RisesAt ψ j ∧ ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k

100	private theorem Q.ext' {a b : Q} (h₁ : a.num = b.num) (h₂ : a.den = b.den) : a = b := by
101	  cases a; cases b; simp_all
102	
103	theorem Q.val_mk' (a : Int) (b : Nat) (hb : 0 < b) : (Q.mk' a b).val = mkRat a b := by
104	  unfold Q.mk' Q.val
105	  rw [dif_pos hb]
106	  simp only
107	  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd a.natAbs b := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ hb
108	  have ha : ((Nat.gcd a.natAbs b : Nat) : Int) ∣ a := Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
109	  have hbd : Nat.gcd a.natAbs b ∣ b := Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
110	  generalize Nat.gcd a.natAbs b = G at hg ha hbd ⊢
111	  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := ha
112	  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hbd
113	  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by omega), Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg, Rat.mkRat_mul_left (Nat.ne_of_gt hg)]

184	theorem build_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Array α → Nat → α) (v : Nat → α) (N : Nat)

188	  intro n hn
189	  induction n with
190	  | zero => simp
191	  | succ n ih =>
192	    obtain ⟨hs, hk⟩ := ih (by omega)

194	    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]

196	    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hk' with h | h

215	    (h0 : s init 0 = v 0) (hs : ∀ m, s (v m) (m + 1) = v (m + 1)) : ∀ n,
216	    ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).1.size = n ∧
217	    (∀ k, k < n → ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).1[k]! = v k) ∧

219	  intro n

226	    have hst : s ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).2 n = v n := by

228	      | zero => simpa using h0
229	      | succ m => rw [h2 m rfl]; exact hs m

234	    · subst h

259	  constructor
260	  · intro h
261	    induction i with
262	    | zero =>
263	      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
264	      cases hv : ψ[0]!.v <;> simp [hv] at h
265	    | succ i ih =>
266	      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
267	      cases hv : ψ[i + 1]!.v <;> simp only [hv, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
268	      · cases hp : ψ[i]!.v <;> simp only [hp] at h
269	        · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih h
270	          refine ⟨by omega, h2, fun k hk1 hk2 => ?_⟩
271	          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk2) with hk | hk
272	          · exact h3 k hk1 (by omega)
273	          · subst hk; refine ⟨by simp [hv], fun ⟨_, hf, _⟩ => ?_⟩
274	            simp [hp] at hf
275	        · cases h
276	          exact ⟨Nat.le_refl _, ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩, fun k h1 h2 => absurd h2 (by omega)⟩
277	        · cases h
278	      · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih h
279	        refine ⟨by omega, h2, fun k hk1 hk2 => ?_⟩
280	        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk2) with hk | hk
281	        · exact h3 k hk1 (by omega)
282	        · subst hk; exact ⟨by simp [hv], fun ⟨_, _, ht⟩ => by simp [hv] at ht⟩
283	      · cases h
284	  · intro ⟨hji, hr, hk⟩
285	    induction i with
286	    | zero => exact absurd hr.1 (by omega)
287	    | succ m ih =>
288	      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hji) with hlt | heq
289	      · have ih' := ih (by omega) (fun k h1 h2 => hk k h1 (by omega))
290	        obtain ⟨hu, hnr⟩ := hk (m + 1) (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
291	        simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
292	        cases hv : ψ[m + 1]!.v with
293	        | u => exact absurd hv hu
294	        | f => exact ih'
295	        | t =>
296	          have hp : ψ[m]!.v = .t := by
297	            cases hp : ψ[m]!.v with
298	            | t => rfl
299	            | f => exact absurd ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩ hnr
300	            | u =>
301	              rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt) with h | h
302	              · exact absurd hp (hk m h (by omega)).1
303	              · subst h; have := hr.2.2; rw [hp] at this; cases this
304	          simp only [hp]; exact ih'
305	      · subst heq
306	        obtain ⟨_, hf, ht⟩ := hr
307	        simp only [startAt, startStep, ht, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
308	        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hf
309	        simp [hf]

312	theorem startAt_none_iff (i : Nat) : startAt op ψ i = .ok none ↔ ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v = .f := by

315	    induction i with
316	    | zero =>
317	      intro k hk; have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
318	      subst hk0
319	      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
320	      cases hv : ψ[0]!.v <;> simp [hv] at h ⊢
321	    | succ i ih =>
322	      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
323	      cases hv : ψ[i + 1]!.v <;> simp only [hv, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
324	      · cases hp : ψ[i]!.v <;> simp only [hp] at h
325	        · have := ih h i (Nat.le_refl _); rw [hp] at this; cases this
326	        · cases h
327	        · cases h
328	      · intro k hk
329	        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk) with hk' | hk'
330	        · exact ih h k (by omega)
331	        · subst hk'; exact hv

335	    | zero => simp [startAt, startStep, h 0 (Nat.le_refl _)]

356	        cases hp : ψ[m]!.v with

358	        | f => exact absurd ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩ hnr

360	          cases m with
361	          | zero => rw [h0] at hp; cases hp
362	          | succ m' => exact absurd hp (h (m' + 1) (by omega) (by omega)).1

394	      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, _, _⟩; omega

407	  | zero =>

409	    cases hr : rate[0]! <;> simp [Run.init] <;> intro k h1 h2 <;> omega
410	  | succ i ih =>
411	    simp only [runAt, runStep]
412	    cases hr : rate[i + 1]! with
413	    | none =>
414	      simp only [Option.isNone_none, if_true, Option.any_some, decide_eq_true_eq]
415	      constructor
416	      · intro h; exact ⟨i + 1, h, Nat.le_refl _, hr⟩
417	      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, _⟩; omega

475	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! =
476	      match startAt op ψ i with
477	      | .error e => .error e
478	      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
479	      | .ok (some j) =>
480	        if (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) then .error (.samplingGap op)
481	        else if (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) then .error missing
482	        else .ok (Q.sub (runAt times rate g i).sum (runAt times rate g j).sum) := by
483	  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll
484	  rw [if_pos hg, getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa using hi)]

486	  rw [runStartAll_get op ψ i hi, runs_get times rate g _ i hi]
487	  cases hs : startAt op ψ i with
488	  | error e => rfl
489	  | ok o =>
490	    cases o with
491	    | none => rfl
492	    | some j =>
493	      simp only [runs_get times rate g _ j (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ((startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs).1 hi)]

497	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.malformed s!"{op} step bound is not positive") := by
498	  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll
499	  rw [if_neg (by simp [hg]), getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa using hi)]
500	  simp

503	    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) :
504	    (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = false := by
505	  cases h : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) with
506	  | false => rfl
507	  | true =>
508	    obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := (lastWide_any_iff i j).mp h
509	    have := (Q.le_iff_not_gt _ _).mp (hgap k h1 h2)
510	    simp only [dt, h3, if_false] at h4
511	    rw [this] at h4; cases h4

513	private theorem rate_of_some {j i : Nat} (hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :

515	  cases h : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) with
516	  | false => rfl
517	  | true =>
518	    obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (lastMissing_any_iff i j).mp h

521	/-- T4: at an observed start with a positive bound, intervals within the bound from the one ending
522	    at the start, and every rate since present, the value is decided and is the discrete sum. -/
523	theorem at_anchor (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
524	    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true)
525	    (hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
526	    ∃ q, (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok q ∧ integral times rate j i = some q.val := by
527	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
528	  simp only [gap_of_le hgap, rate_of_some hrate, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]

531	/-- The value at a start whose bracket interval is within the bound is zero. -/
532	theorem zero_at_anchor (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (j : Nat) (hj : j < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j j)
533	    (hgap : Q.le (Q.sub times[j]! times[j - 1]!) g = true) :
534	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[j]! = .ok Q.zero := by
535	  rw [get_pos hg j hj, (startAt_some_iff j j).mpr ha]
536	  have hw := gap_of_le (times := times) (rate := rate) (j := j) (i := j)

538	                       subst this; exact hgap)
539	  have hm := rate_of_some (times := times) (rate := rate) (g := g) (j := j) (i := j)
540	    (fun k h1 h2 => absurd h2 (by omega))
541	  simp only [hw, hm, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Q.sub_self]

543	/-- T5: a decided value comes from a positive bound and an observed start, intervals within the

545	theorem decided_anchored (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (q : Q)
546	    (h : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok q) :
547	    Q.lt Q.zero g = true ∧ ∃ j, AnchorAt ψ j i ∧
548	      (∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) ∧
549	      (∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) ∧
550	      integral times rate j i = some q.val := by
551	  cases hg : Q.lt Q.zero g with
552	  | false => rw [not_positive hg i hi] at h; cases h
553	  | true =>
554	    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
555	    rw [get_pos hg i hi] at h
556	    cases hs : startAt op ψ i with
557	    | error e => simp only [hs] at h; cases h
558	    | ok o =>
559	      cases o with
560	      | none => simp only [hs] at h; cases h
561	      | some j =>
562	        simp only [hs] at h
563	        have ha := (startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs
564	        cases hw : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) with
565	        | true => simp [hw] at h
566	        | false =>
567	          cases hm : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) with
568	          | true => simp [hw, hm] at h
569	          | false =>
570	            simp only [hw, hm, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Except.ok.injEq] at h
571	            have hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true := by
572	              intro k h1 h2
573	              have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by have := ha.2.1.1; omega
574	              cases hgt : Q.gt (dt times k) g with
575	              | false => simp only [dt, hk0, if_false] at hgt; exact (Q.le_iff_not_gt _ _).mpr hgt
576	              | true =>
577	                have := (lastWide_any_iff (rate := rate) i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hk0, hgt⟩
578	                rw [hw] at this; cases this
579	            have hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome := by
580	              intro k h1 h2
581	              cases hr : rate[k]! with
582	              | some _ => rfl
583	              | none =>
584	                have := (lastMissing_any_iff (times := times) (g := g) i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hr⟩
585	                rw [hm] at this; cases this
586	            refine ⟨j, ha, hgap, hrate, ?_⟩
587	            rw [integral_eq_sum j i ha.1 hrate, ← h, Q.val_sub]
588	
589	/-- T6: ψ false at every observation so far: unknown, truncated. -/
590	theorem none_observed (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v = .f) :
591	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
592	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_none_iff i).mpr h]
593	
594	/-- T6: ψ true at the first observation and known with no definite rise since: unknown, truncated. -/
595	theorem onset_before_recording (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h0 : ψ[0]!.v = .t)
596	    (h : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k) :
597	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by

599	
600	/-- T6: no observed start: unknown. -/
601	theorem no_anchor_unknown (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h : ¬ ∃ j, AnchorAt ψ j i) :
602	    ∃ e, (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error e := by
603	  cases hd : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! with
604	  | error e => exact ⟨e, rfl⟩
605	  | ok q => obtain ⟨_, j, ha, _⟩ := decided_anchored i hi q hd; exact absurd ⟨j, ha⟩ h
606	
607	/-- T7: an interval longer than the bound ending at an observation of `[j, i]`: a sampling gap. -/
608	theorem wide_interval (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
609	    (hk : ∃ k, j ≤ k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ Q.gt (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) :
610	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.samplingGap op) := by
611	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
612	  obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hk
613	  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by have := ha.2.1.1; omega
614	  have : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = true :=

619	theorem bracket_wide (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)

621	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.samplingGap op) :=

623	
624	/-- T7: a missing rate since the start, with every interval within the bound: `missing`. -/
625	theorem missing_rate (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
626	    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true)
627	    (hk : ∃ k, j < k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ rate[k]! = none) :
628	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error missing := by
629	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
630	  have : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = true := (lastMissing_any_iff i j).mpr hk
631	  simp only [gap_of_le hgap, this, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
632	
633	/-- T8: the value at `i` depends only on the times, rates and ψ at observations `≤ i`. -/
634	theorem causal {times' : Array Q} {rate' : Array (Option Q)} {ψ' : Array R} (i : Nat)
635	    (hi : i < ψ.size) (hi' : i < ψ'.size)
636	    (ht : ∀ k, k ≤ i → times[k]! = times'[k]!) (hr : ∀ k, k ≤ i → rate[k]! = rate'[k]!)
637	    (hψ : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]! = ψ'[k]!) :
638	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = (sinceRiseIntegralAll times' rate' g op missing ψ')[i]! := by
639	  cases hg : Q.lt Q.zero g with
640	  | false => rw [not_positive hg i hi, not_positive hg i hi']
641	  | true =>
642	    rw [get_pos hg i hi, get_pos hg i hi', startAt_congr i hψ, runAt_congr i ht hr]
643	    cases hs : startAt op ψ' i with
644	    | error e => rfl
645	    | ok o =>
646	      cases o with
647	      | none => rfl
648	      | some j =>
649	        have hj : j ≤ i := ((startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs).1
650	        simp only [runAt_congr j (fun k hk => ht k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hr k (by omega))]
651	
652	/-- T9: the sum splits at any intermediate observation. -/
653	theorem integral_split (j m i : Nat) (hjm : j ≤ m) (hmi : m ≤ i) :
654	    integral times rate j i = (do let a ← integral times rate j m; let b ← integral times rate m i; pure (a + b)) := by
655	  induction i with
656	  | zero =>
657	    have h1 : m = 0 := by omega
658	    have h2 : j = 0 := by omega
659	    subst h1; subst h2; simp [integral, Rat.add_zero]
660	  | succ i ih =>
661	    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmi) with hlt | heq
662	    · have hj : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ j) := by omega
663	      have hm : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ m) := by omega
664	      simp only [integral, hj, hm, if_false, ih (by omega)]
665	      cases integral times rate j m <;> cases integral times rate m i <;> cases rate[i + 1]! <;>
666	        simp [Rat.add_assoc]
667	    · subst heq
668	      rw [integral_le _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)]
669	      cases integral times rate j (i + 1) <;> simp [Rat.add_zero]

672	theorem accumulates (i i' j : Nat) (hi' : i' < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i') (hji : j ≤ i) (hii : i ≤ i')
673	    (a b : Q) (h1 : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok a)
674	    (h2 : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i']! = .ok b) :

685	  have hs := integral_split (times := times) (rate := rate) j i i' hji hii

687	  cases hx : integral times rate i i' with
688	  | none => rw [hx] at hs; simp at hs
689	  | some x =>

691	    simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def, Option.some.injEq] at hs
